content.title: CSS Is Presentation
content.hook: You already know how HTML gives a page structure and meaning. CSS gives that structure a visual presentation.
content.context:
Think of the same HTML wearing different clothes. The person did not change. The presentation did.

For this module, keep one simple model in your head: HTML says what the content is; CSS says how that content should look and feel on the page.
goals: Understand that CSS changes how existing HTML is presented without changing what the elements mean.
